description: Evidence manifest for proving the production identity provider and frontend OIDC client registration are deployed for platform browser login.
rules: issuer, authorization_endpoint, token_endpoint, jwks_uri, redirect_uris, and post_logout_redirect_uris must be HTTPS and must not use localhost
discovery issuer must match manifest issuer
authorization code flow and S256 PKCE must be supported
JWKS must be fetched and expose at least one asymmetric signing algorithm
frontend clients must be public, require PKCE, and must not have client secrets
clients must include openid, profile, and platform API access scopes
browser login, redirect state, token exchange, access token audience, and role claim verification must pass
access tokens must not be stored in localStorage and logout must clear the session
notes: This validator checks captured IdP deployment evidence only. It does not call IdP endpoints, exchange tokens, or persist sessions.
